Run Device Owner commands from any terminal (Termux, adb shell and others), like rish for Shizuku. Export the dish and dish_dhizukuf.dex files and start dish.
Could not export the dish files

Copy both files to a folder where your terminal can run scripts, then start dish:

Termux (run termux-setup-storage once):
cp /sdcard/PATH_TO_FOLDER/dish* $PREFIX/bin/
chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/dish
dish help

adb (from a computer):
adb push dish dish_dhizukuf.dex /data/local/tmp/
adb shell sh /data/local/tmp/dish help

Any other terminal: sh /path/to/dish help

Keep both files together. On the first run DhizukuF asks you to approve access, like for any other app. Most commands need DhizukuF to be the Device Owner (Profile Owner support is limited).

Profile Owner mode: dish works, but commands that need the full Device Owner (reboot, adb, timezone, private DNS and others) are unavailable.

dish is not a terminal inside this app. It is a command-line tool: export the files, then run dish in a terminal app, best of all in Termux.

1. Tap Export dish files and pick a folder.
2. In Termux run termux-setup-storage once, copy dish and dish_dhizukuf.dex to $PREFIX/bin and run chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/dish.
3. Type dish to open the console, or dish help for the commands.

Shown in the title of DhizukuF and on the launcher shortcut of your own picture. Android cannot rename the launcher entry of an installed app: the two built-in icons keep their names (DhizukuF and Dhizuku). Empty means DhizukuF. The package name never changes.

The DhizukuF icon and the icon of the original Dhizuku switch the launcher entry of the app (the package name stays the same). A picture of your own becomes a launcher shortcut with your name and is also used inside DhizukuF. The built-in icons cannot be deleted.

Keeps your name and icon when DhizukuF is updated (beta or release). When off, an update puts them back to the default ones.

On a TV the launcher shows the wide banner of the chosen entry (shown below). A TV launcher takes it from the app itself, so only the two built-in entries can change it; your own pictures are used inside DhizukuF only. The launcher may need a few seconds, or a restart of the launcher, to refresh.
